facts.fact: Finance minister Godongwana pointed to South Africa's continued absence of an AI strategy; TechCentral adds the World Bank does not count South Africa among countries with one.
TechCentral reports the draft policy was gazetted 10 April and withdrawn 16 days later, and that a revised draft is due at cabinet in November with public consultation targeted for January 2027.
